review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: There is an opinion that school should reward students who show the best academic results; other believe that it is more important to reward students who show improvements. From my perspective, there are strong cases to be made for both sides of the argument.

Admittedly, one might argue that school reward students who show the best academic results is sure because students are having diligently applied themselves to their studies, therefore, they deserve their praise and privileges and this may encourage these students and others to study harder to win the rewards. It naturally student propel towards overall academic gains. This kind of competition, seen in almost every aspect of life and where only the best individuals are rewarded. This means that students are used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition and enable them to achieve success in later life.

However, this line of reasoning, I strongly believe that it is more important to reward students who show improvements. Only a few smart students can come first and receive the rewards. This cause others to think that their effort is futile because they can not surpass those outstanding individuals. Students prone to feeling overwhelmed and disheartened, gradually lose the incentive to study. Thereby, emphasizing improvements, encouraging all students to be diligent in their studies and help students to understand that they need to constantly improve themselves. In this sense, irrespective of how well they have been or are performing and the constant desire to outdo themselves. Even though, benefit themselves more than the competitive determination to win against all others.
Overall, it seems to me that both views are valid to a certain extent. Thought, students is the best academic results or reward students who show improvements should praise also.

completion.comment: Bài có mở bài, hai thân bài và kết bài trên các trang đã xác minh.

review.overall: Em viết đủ bốn phần và nêu được cả hai hướng thưởng; Body 1 có nỗ lực học tập và cạnh tranh, Body 2 có nguy cơ nản lòng và lợi ích tự cải thiện. Tuy nhiên, một số câu bị chắp mệnh đề tùy ý, như “It naturally student propel”, “This cause others” và “Students prone”, khiến quan hệ nhân quả không hoàn chỉnh. Câu kết cũng sai đến mức lập trường khó đọc, còn nhiều phần mở bài gần nguyên cách diễn đạt đề. Em cần viết lại các câu sai theo khung đã học, giữ ý riêng của em và tự kiểm tra động từ chính trong từng câu. Body 1 gộp câu chủ đề với lý do công sức và chuyển sang cạnh tranh bằng một mảnh câu; Body 2 vào ý nản chí ngay rồi dùng “Thereby” cho lợi ích tiến bộ, khiến ý thứ hai bị hiểu sai là hệ quả của ý trước. Bản cũ đánh dấu chuyển ý Đạt nên bỏ sót quan hệ này.

paragraphs: Some people believe that schools should reward students with the best academic results, while others believe that recognizing students who have made progress deserves greater attention. From my perspective, there are strong cases to be made for rewarding both groups.

Supporters of rewarding top achievers argue that schools should reward students with the best academic results. The first reason is that these students have diligently applied themselves to their studies. They therefore deserve their praise and privileges. This may encourage these students and others to study harder to win rewards. As a result, their effort may raise academic performance overall. Furthermore, this kind of competition is seen in almost every aspect of life, where only the best individuals are rewarded. This means that students can become used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition, which may enable them to achieve success in later life.

Advocates of rewarding progress argue that schools should also reward students who show improvements. To begin with, if only a few high-achieving students receive rewards, this can cause others to think that their effort is futile. This is because they cannot surpass those outstanding individuals. These students are prone to feeling overwhelmed and disheartened and may gradually lose the incentive to study. Furthermore, rewarding progress can encourage all students to be diligent in their studies and help students to understand that they need to constantly improve themselves. They can continue to improve irrespective of how well they have been or are performing. The desire to outdo themselves may benefit them more than the determination to defeat others.
Overall, it seems to me that both views are valid to a certain extent. Schools should reward both students with the best academic results and those who have made progress.

task.text:
Some people think that school should reward students who show the best academic results, while others believe that it is more important to reward students who show improvements.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
